notes: Five distinct manipulation episodes are visible: one chair backrest and four separate barbecue parts. The first approximately 280 frames include a camera survey plus the chair adjustment; survey motion alone was not counted. The two barbecue side shelves are treated as separate movable parts. Their retraction moments are less directly observed than their extension moments.
scene_description: A person moves around an apartment balcony containing a white adjustable lounge chair and a stainless-steel gas barbecue, manipulating the chair backrest, barbecue lid, lower cabinet door, and two separate folding side shelves.
